[[Kayin's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Lieutenant Kayin]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Arkjok Ward]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[Channeling Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Channeling Focus]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Channeling Focus]] from collectors [[Kiishen]] or [[Yiwong]] or crafter [[Sheco]]
OR
*[[Channeling Focus]] from collector [[Danira]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*[[Channeling Focus]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
AND
*Black [[dye]]
